rationale: The inline success shape is extracted as InvitationAcceptResponse so the response has a stable named schema without changing its fields.

id.description: The unique ID of the invitation.

email.description: The email address of the recipient.

accepted_at.description: The timestamp when the invitation was accepted, or null if not yet accepted.

revoked_at.description: The timestamp when the invitation was revoked, or null if not revoked.

expires_at.description: The timestamp when the invitation expires.

organization_id.description: The ID of the [organization](/reference/organization) that the recipient will join.

inviter_user_id.description: The ID of the user who invited the recipient, if provided.

accepted_user_id.description: The ID of the user who accepted the invitation, once accepted.

role_slug.description: Slug of the role the invitee will be assigned on acceptance. Reflects the current role on the invitee's organization membership. null when the invitation has no associated organization.

token.description: The token used to accept the invitation.

accept_invitation_url.description: The URL where the recipient can accept the invitation.

provenance.observed: The operation declares its InvitationAcceptResponse success shape inline at /paths/~1user_management~1invitations~1{id}~1accept/post/responses/200/content/application~1json/schema.
provenance.specd: The SDK exposes the same success shape through the named InvitationAcceptResponse component.
